frozenContract.correctionNote: Findings F1-F5 of CORRECTION-01 and the residual F2 of CORRECTION-02 implement requirements the freeze already carried (effective-severity authority over debt, capability declared and registered rather than inferred, human-review propagation, a bounded versioned dimension registry). No frozen canonical contract was rewritten semantically.

inScope: Domain-neutral, typed, deterministic M01 quality kernel package iris_quality/
QualityJudge and AssetValidator ports as the only route for real evaluators
Evaluator and domain-profile registries with trust tiers and version binding
Decision engine, promotion ladder, blocker codes and quality-debt policy
Canonical serialization with content digests and strict schema round trip
Three synthetic profile fixtures in examples/ plus their contract tests
F1: rule quality debt against the authoritative effective severity so an effective FATAL is never deferrable
F2: fail-closed evaluator authority from contract declaration plus registry-resolved coverage
F3: propagate JudgeResult human-review requests into dimension outcomes and block silent promotion
F4: bounded, versioned, persisted Dimension Registry admitting non-visual extension dimensions
F5: restate the Evidence Bundle against measured Git diffs and bind the exact corrected head to its Governance run
F2 (residual): make registry-backed authority the only promotion-capable evaluation path, with an explicitly named non-promoting preflight authority
outOfScope: Real domain evaluators, vendor SDK adapters, Blender/ComfyUI/WebGPU providers
Persistence, queueing and the promotion executor that consumes QualityDecision
Any change to the frozen planning documents or checkpoint files
stopCondition: Correction execution stops once registry-backed authority is mandatory for every promotion-capable evaluator input, the mandatory regression tests and the full suite pass, exact-head Governance is successful, the Evidence Bundle is truthful, and the commits are pushed to PR #7 for independent re-review.
